title: Universal local finite-free models of proper relatively flat direct images
statement: For a proper finitely presented f:X→T [def-pc-morphism-conventions] and a finitely presented O_X-module F flat over T, every t∈T has an open neighbourhood V and a termwise finite-free complex P of O_V-modules [def-weil-pbc-free-module] supported in [0,d] for some natural number d. For every cartesian base change f′:X′→T′ along g:T′→V→T, H^q(g^*P) is isomorphic to R^q f′_*F′ for every q≥0. The isomorphisms are not asserted canonical or functorial.

proof.text: Use lem-pc-proper-flat-cech-model to choose U,C,Q,d, the quasi-isomorphism e and the universal comparisons for C.
Apply lem-pc-flat-model-finite-free-shortening at t to obtain V≤U and P. Its structural properties are precisely IsFiniteFreeComplex P d.

For a cartesian square over g:T′→V, composition with the open inclusion V→U gives the square over U, since (V→U)≫U.ι=V.ι. Compose the homology isomorphism H^q(g^*P)≅H^q((g≫V→U)^*C) with the universal C comparison to R^q f′_*F′.

lean.statement: theorem exists_isFiniteFreeComplex_higherDirectImage (hℱ : ℱ.IsFlatOver f) (t : T) : ∃ (U : T.Opens) (P : CochainComplex U.toScheme.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ), t ∈ U ∧ IsFiniteFreeComplex P d ∧ ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ U.toScheme) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T') [HasInjectiveResolutions X'.Modules], IsPullback g' f' f (g ≫ U.ι) → ∀ q : ℕ, Nonempty ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P).homology q ≅ (higherDirectImage f' q).obj ((Modules.pullback g').obj ℱ))
